question: In the morning 136 guests checked into the resort. In the afternoon 67 more arrived, and then 63 more. In the evening every guest was given 4 dinner tokens, and 11 extra tokens were issued to staff. How many dinner tokens were issued?

The bakery had 15 boxes, each with 2 layers of 9 muffins, and stacked all the muffins on the counter. It sold 146 muffins and gave 25 away as samples. Then 73 fresh muffins were added to the counter. How many muffins are on the counter?

In the morning the warehouse held 187 crates, shipped 184, and found 2 damaged, which were checked twice. In the afternoon 73 crates arrived and 55 were shipped. In the evening each remaining crate was opened, and each holds 6 jars. How many jars were unpacked?

Bo had 14 stamps and received 55 more. He traded every stamp for 3 coins. He spent 116 coins on a game and earned 66 coins washing windows. Each coin is worth 8 points, and Cleo has fewer points than Bo. How many points does Bo have?

The sailmaker had 84 yards of canvas and received 20 yards, then 4 more. The loft is 9 metres tall. She used 66 yards on a mainsail and bought 65 yards more. She measures the offcut store in feet, at 3 feet to a yard. How many feet of canvas are in the offcut store?

In the morning the dairy had 15 gallons of cream and received 69 more, recorded in pints at 8 pints to a gallon, and 337 pints were sold. In the afternoon each remaining pint sold for 6 dollars, and 1031 dollars went to the farmer. In the evening 69 dollars in tips were added. How many dollars does the dairy have?

The soup kitchen made 174 pints of stew and serves it in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. It served 147 cups at lunch, then a volunteer brought 40 cups more. At dinner 221 cups were served, and 66 cups were sent from another kitchen. How many cups of stew are left?

Tom had 44 coupons and collected 20 more. The store has 3 floors. He used 52 coupons, and each remaining coupon was worth 4 points on his card. A birthday bonus added 39 points, and a promotion doubled his points. How many points are on Tom's card?

In the morning Mo had 228 gallons of cider and sold 216 to a pub. In the afternoon he measured the rest in pints, at 8 pints to a gallon, and shared them equally among 6 stalls. In the evening the first stall received 65 more pints. Mo's rival Ana sold fewer gallons than Mo. How many pints does the first stall have?

In the morning the grocer received 44 crates and then 58 more. The truck was 15 minutes late. In the afternoon each crate was unpacked, 9 jars to a crate, and 36 jars were found in the back room. In the evening every jar sold for 8 dollars. How many dollars did the jars bring in?

Ada had 157 tiles, used 140 on the floor, and broke 13, though a dozen helpers had offered to carry them. She cut each remaining tile into 8 strips and each strip into 4 pieces for the mosaic tray. She used 29 pieces on the border. How many pieces are in the mosaic tray?

Ivy had 169 shells and doubled her collection at the beach. She was given 56 shells and lost 3. Each shell is worth 5 points, and a bonus tripled her points. Ivy has more points than Jude. How many points does Ivy have?

The distillery has 177 vats, each vat holds 6 barrels, each barrel holds 5 kegs, and each keg holds 9 gallons. The stock is valued by the pint, at 8 pints to a gallon, and each pint is valued at 5 dollars in the ledger. How many dollars is the ledger value?

The juice stand had 239 gallons of juice, recorded in quarts at 4 quarts to a gallon. A delivery added 30 quarts, and 535 quarts were sold. The owner then doubled the remaining stock by pressing the same amount again. Juice is served in cups, at 4 cups to a quart. How many cups can the stand serve?

In the morning 216 tickets were printed; 57 were sold and 2 were torn. In the afternoon each remaining ticket was booked at 9 points on the points board, and 52 bonus points were added. In the evening the points were split equally among 5 volunteers. How many points does the first volunteer get?

In the morning the nursery had 65 trays and removed 15, checking the count twice. Each tray has 3 rows, and each row has 6 pots. In the afternoon each pot was planted with 3 seedlings. In the evening each seedling showed 6 leaves. How many leaves were counted?

The electrician had 68 yards of cable, used 25 yards, and bought 55 more. The electrician has 2 apprentices. He measures cable in feet, at 3 feet to a yard. He used 209 feet on a house, found 26 feet damaged, and received 61 feet from a supplier. How many feet of cable does he have?

The dairy had 115 gallons of milk and received 9 more, recorded in pints at 8 pints to a gallon. The shop has 3 fridges. It sold 506 pints and lost 291 pints to spoilage. Each remaining pint sold for 6 dollars, and 48 dollars in tips were added. How many dollars did the dairy take?

Max has a 76 week project shared equally between 2 teams. Team A has finished 22 of its weeks, and Max writes the rest on the countdown board in days, at 7 days to a week. Then 26 days are added to the board for testing, and 7 days are removed. How many days are on the countdown board?

In the morning 195 pears were shared equally among 3 stalls, and Ana's stall received 55 more. The market has 40 stalls. In the afternoon 5 of Ana's pears were rotten and thrown away. In the evening 41 pears were delivered to her stall. By evening Ana's stall had more pears than Rui's. How many pears does Ana's stall have?

In the morning the landscaper had 167 square yards of turf and received 68 more, but 18 square yards were damaged. In the afternoon he converted the rest to square feet, since a square yard is 9 square feet, and added 11 square feet of offcuts. In the evening he laid 1712 square feet. How many square feet of turf are left?

The shop received 163 boxes of candles and 8 more, with 8 candles in each box, and set them on the candle rack. The shop is 5 minutes from the station. Then 59 candles, 50 candles, and 18 candles were added to the rack. How many candles are on the rack?
The kite shop had 93 kites and sold 76. The shop is 30 years old. It received 38 kites, then 4, then 22. The kites were packed equally into 3 boxes. How many kites are in the first box?

In the morning the crew laid 6 lines of cable, each 60 fathoms long. In the afternoon they added 5 fathoms at the pier and 69 fathoms along the wall. In the evening they recorded the total in feet, since a fathom is 6 feet. How many feet of cable did they record?

In the morning 72 guests arrived at the wedding, then 57 more, then 30. The hall has 25 tables. In the afternoon 58 guests arrived and 17 left. In the evening every guest was given 4 drink tokens, and 43 tokens were handed to the staff. How many drink tokens were handed out?
